notes.title: Monster Stalker: Prologue v1.01 Update
notes.content:
Update descriptions:
1. Add rest spot before the hidden battle.
2. Fix the bug that teammate’s health bar value can be dragged.
3. Fix the bug that in “VS” page sometimes enemies block victory condition text. 
4. Fix the bug that if beat Test Body before it transforms, victory window not showed.
5. In Menu page, click “new game” button will need double confirmation in case misoperation. 
6. Adjust balance of some badge functions. 
7. Adjust balance of some card functions.
8. Adjust balance of some enemies.
9. Adjust prices of store cards and card delete function.
10. Adjust cash got from battles.
11. Adjust some reward cards got from battles.
12. Revise some card descriptions.
13. Fix some other bugs.

Because some bugs and experience issues connected to player’s previously saved data, I suggest to start a new game to experience the whole updates.  

Thank you for playing the game!

notes.title: Recent Updates of Demo v0.7 and v0.9
notes.content:
Demo v0.7 and v0.9 updates include:

1. Added new artwork for 25 cards.

2. Added auto save feature. 

3. Improved Badge system.

4. Added game guide. 

5. Improved dashboard page menu UI.

6. Added support to Traditional Chinese.

7. Improved game story.

8. Some bug fix.

Have fun!

notes.title: Recent Updates, Monster Stalker Prologue Demo v0.5
notes.content:
